summary_line: Two account notices need a look, and the garden-sensor build is signed but not yet proven on the device.
telegram_line: The account notices come first; the garden-sensor build only needs its on-device install proof before the weekend.

cron: Dex filed the garden-sensor release checklist: build 42 is signed and 120 tests are green, but the on-device install and the offline launch remain open.
Two account-change notices landed one minute apart; Dex filed a read-only triage and took no account or money action.
Follow-ups for the recipe app and the reading list were staged; none was accepted.

decisions: You still owe a check that both account notices are legitimate, in the official app.
The garden-sensor build stays open until the device install and the offline launch are proven.
The recipe app should not get another paid test run before its report is readable.
Four old approval cards, 40 to 134 days old, still wait for a close-or-keep call.
patterns: The garden-sensor bottleneck moved from features to release proof, and manual checks still lag the automation around them.
The priorities page is 40 days stale, so the daily board keeps compensating for it.
proposals: Carry the account checks as a short-lived admin item until they're resolved.
Keep the garden-sensor build marked signed-but-unproven until the install receipts land.
Gate the recipe app's next paid run behind a readable report.
Rewrite the priorities page after the weekend with explicit active, paused and dropped calls.
